integrity: Exact analytic cyclotomic-field and eigenspace proof, accompanied by finite modular-Krylov checks; these finite checks are not substituted for infinite-prime proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite adjacency-based single-excitation open grids; strictly positive local absorbers; positive rational directional coupling ratio for the all-prime dichotomy; maximally mixed initial condition. No assertion for all irrational ratios, finite-time speed, internal trapping sites, disorder, decoherence or many-body effects. Independent historical priority remains unverified.
title: Arithmetic spectral switch and corner-capture geometry on prime-sided quantum grids
